item.title: Early Alert: Compact Medical Removes and Updates Use Instructions for ButterflyBVM Bag-Valve-Mask Resuscitators
item.description: Compact Medical removes and updates use instructions for certain ButterflyBVM devices due to development of holes in bellows.

item.title: Early Alert: B. Braun Medical Inc. Removes Streamline Bloodline Set for Dialog+
item.description: The dialyzer connector may not be attached appropriately, resulting in leaking and potential blood loss.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Advises Consumers Not to Buy or Serve Once Upon a Farm Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars
item.description: Consumers Should Not Buy or Serve Once Upon a Farm Tractor Wheels, Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars Due to a Potentially Fatal Choking Hazard
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Platelet Factor 4 (PF4) Radioimmunoassay Recall: Instrumentation Laboratories Removes HemosIL AcuStar HIT-IgG(PF4-H)
item.description: Product performance issue may lead to a false negative result which will delay recognition of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Hospital Glucose Meter Correction: Nova Biomedical Updates Use Instructions for StatStrip Glucose Hospital Meter Systems
item.description: Update use instructions for StatStrip Glucose Hospital Meter Systems due to the potential for glucose results to be assigned to the incorrect patient.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Medline Removes or Corrects All Medline Brand Beds and Accessories
item.description: Medline removes or corrects all brand beds & accessories due to fire, electrical overheating, entrapment & asphyxiation risks. Risk of serious injury or death.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Update: Import Alert for Certain Olympus Medical Devices Manufactured in Japan - Letter to Health Care Providers
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is alerting health care providers about import alerts for certain medical devices manufactured in Japan by Olympus Medical Systems Corporation (Olympus) and its subsidiaries.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Cardinal Health Updates Use Instructions for Presource Packs Containing BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets
item.description: Cardinal Health Presource Kits may contain BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets with Updated Use Instructions.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Cardinal Health Issues Correction for Presource Packs Containing BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets
item.description: Cardinal Health Presource Kits containing recalled BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets should be corrected prior to continued use.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Diagnostic Ultrasound System Correction: Philips Ultrasound Issues Updated Use Instructions for Lumify Diagnostic Ultrasound System
item.description: A software app or transducer connection problem with the Philips Lumify diagnostic ultrasound system can result in loss of or delays in scanning functionality.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Transcatheter Mitral Valve Delivery System Issue from Edwards Lifesciences
item.description: Potential balloon burst during inflation can lead to embolism or the need for surgery.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Infusion Set Recall: BD and CareFusion 303, Inc. Remove BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets
item.description: BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets are being removed and discontinued; Alaris Pump Module model 8100 has updated performance data
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Convenience Kit Recall: AVID Medical Removes Convenience Kits Affected by BD ChloraPrep Applicator Recall
item.description: Avid Medical is removing certain convenience kits affected by the BD ChloraPrep Applicator Recall that may be contaminated with Aspergillus penicillioides.
